name: Sunday Hail Mary
quote: Revised combined price and boost: not verified
quote_context: Individual DraftKings Network prices observed October 10 around 6:23 PM ET; public multi-jurisdiction snapshots may differ from your app. The original screenshot's boosted price belongs to the original 13-leg slip and does not apply to this revision. No stake is assigned.
copy_text: Build a 11-leg moneyline parlay for Sunday October 11, 2026: Jacksonville Jaguars over Philadelphia Eagles; Cincinnati Bengals over Miami Dolphins; Houston Texans over Tennessee Titans; Las Vegas Raiders over New England Patriots; Washington Commanders over New York Giants; Cleveland Browns over New York Jets; Green Bay Packers over Chicago Bears; Pittsburgh Steelers over Indianapolis Colts; Detroit Lions over Arizona Cardinals; Seattle Seahawks over San Francisco 49ers; Atlanta Falcons over Baltimore Ravens. Exact teams and games only; do not substitute props or alternate games. Show current available odds.

legs.why: Keep: Philadelphia is missing Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Marquise Brown. Analyst lean: Jacksonville has the cleaner offensive setup; the heavy favorite price buys win probability, not a demonstrated edge.
legs.risk: Jaguars corner Jaylon Jones is out and Eric Murray doubtful. A neutral-site game and one turnover swing can defeat an expensive favorite.

legs.why: Keep conditionally: Miami is 0-4 and its passing production has been poor; Cincinnati's defensive line gets B.J. Hill back. This is an analyst preference, not a model moneyline.
legs.risk: Chase remains in concussion protocol and both he and Higgins are questionable despite full Friday practices. Remove/review this leg if both are inactive.

legs.why: Keep, but weaker than its price suggests: Tennessee is without defensive backs Amani Hooker and Joshua Williams. The market favors Houston by seven, but both teams are 0-4.
legs.risk: Houston's offensive line has an out and multiple illness question marks. Divisional variance and protection problems make -355 a fragile anchor.

legs.why: Keep as an intentional upset swing: New England is missing both starting corners and additional secondary depth. That creates a plausible route for Las Vegas to outperform the underdog price.
legs.risk: Raiders receiver depth is also depleted, Jeanty is questionable, and they are road underdogs. The injury mismatch has no quantified fair-moneyline adjustment.

legs.why: Keep conditionally: Washington confirmed Jayden Daniels will start, restoring its preferred quarterback setup. Home field is part of the qualitative case.
legs.risk: Diggs is out, McLaurin questionable and Washington's secondary is depleted. Daniels returns with an elbow brace. Current stadium weather retrieval failed; earlier rain warnings remain unresolved.

legs.why: Keep as a high-variance upset: New York is missing Breece Hall and other offensive pieces. Cleveland has a credible route in a lower-scoring game, but this is qualitative inference.
legs.risk: Cleveland is missing multiple defensive tackles and Teven Jenkins. NWS forecasts rain with gusts up to 29 mph; that adds turnover and kicking variance rather than automatically favoring Cleveland.

legs.why: Keep as an upset swing: home underdog with Chicago quarterback Caleb Williams questionable. Chicago also lost Kyle Monangai. The total is 46.5, up from the noon 45.5 snapshot.
legs.risk: Green Bay's offensive line has two doubtful players and another questionable. If Williams plays effectively, the main uncertainty supporting this lean shrinks.

legs.why: Keep with caution: Indianapolis is missing three receiving options plus Arden Key and Jaylon Carlies. Pittsburgh has the home setting in a matchup priced around a field goal.
legs.risk: Pittsburgh is missing Michael Pittman, Jamel Dean and DeShon Elliott, with Ramsey questionable. NWS forecasts Sunday rain and east winds 11-15 mph; final inactives may change the balance.

legs.why: Keep: Detroit remains the market's 5.5-point favorite. Arizona's Harrison trade/inactive reporting is additional context, but a completed transaction was not independently confirmed during this recheck.
legs.risk: Detroit is missing center Cade Mays, guard Ben Bartch, Brian Branch and Rock Ya-Sin. A 54.5 total leaves room for a volatile scoring game; the favorite is not a safe leg.

legs.why: Keep: Seattle has home field and confirmed Leonard Williams ready to play. San Francisco is without Nick Bosa, a meaningful pass-rush absence.
legs.risk: San Francisco enters 4-0. Seattle has running-back and defensive-depth absences. Division familiarity and the opponent's record make this a competitive final leg.

legs.why: Add the missing Sunday-night game: Baltimore confirmed Tyler Huntley will start for injured Lamar Jackson, and the Ravens also lack center Cam Jurgens and edge Trey Hendrickson. Analyst lean: Atlanta has the clearer quarterback setup at home. Atlanta's official preview reports 48.3 rushing yards allowed per game, but four-game form does not guarantee it can contain Henry.
legs.risk: Huntley and Derrick Henry can sustain a run-heavy attack. Zay Flowers and Marlon Humphrey are questionable; Atlanta left tackle Jake Matthews is questionable. Atlanta downgraded Za'Darius Smith to OUT Saturday; Ebukam and Deablo remain questionable. These absences weaken the run/pressure case. Roof status is not verified, so no quantified weather adjustment is assigned.

why: Revised from the owner's 13-leg ticket. Removed New Orleans (unresolved receiver/tackle and Kamara availability on both sides), Los Angeles Chargers (seven ruled out, Slater on IR, McConkey questionable), and Buffalo (Monday game, Palmer/Oliver out). Added Atlanta for the missing Sunday-night game. Kept three explicit underdog swings rather than flipping every uncertain matchup into another expensive favorite. Original selections and prices are preserved below in this immutable research release.
risk: Eleven results must all succeed. Injury, turnover and weather uncertainty compound; no validated moneyline/parlay model, fair price, numerical edge, EV or hit rate is established. v0.3 supports yardage props only. No official pick, challenge leg or automatic bankroll entry is created.
next: Before the 9:30 AM ET London kickoff, confirm current prices and final London inactives. Recheck CIN receivers, WAS receivers, GB offensive line/CHI quarterback and weather. Later Sunday final inactives will not be known before the full ticket's first game; omit uncertain legs or wait for individual games rather than assume clearance. This card stops accepting pregame copies at first kickoff.
